note: Opener pairs only: this file carries no token ids, because the split is a property of a tokenizer, not of the word. Every pair is resolved against the artifact's own vocabulary in two contexts (bare, i.e. the first token of a response, and leads_with_space, i.e. mid-sentence), and the resolved ids must each be exactly one token in both contexts or the command refuses. The map is a transposition per pair: the denial row and the compliance row exchange places, which is a bijection on the chosen ids and leaves every other row untouched. 'As' is deliberately absent: it opens the base model's third attested refusal shape ('As a language model, I do not condone ...') but is a high-frequency discourse marker, so it is left unmapped as the negative control.
